patch.summary: Update an attribute and optionally replace its options
patch.description: Type and full option-set changes are atomic. Returns 422 without changing the attribute, options, values, or audit log when an existing product or legacy migration value would become invalid. Compatible conversions, option additions, label/order changes, and removal of unused option values are allowed.

delete.summary: Delete an attribute and its options
delete.description: Returns 422 without deleting anything when product or legacy migration values still reference the attribute.

put.summary: Replace: Update an attribute and optionally replace its options
put.description: Type and full option-set changes are atomic. Returns 422 without changing the attribute, options, values, or audit log when an existing product or legacy migration value would become invalid. Compatible conversions, option additions, label/order changes, and removal of unused option values are allowed.

get.summary: List attributes assigned to a category

put.summary: Replace attributes assigned to a category
put.description: Atomically replaces category assignments, including per-assignment requiredness. Returns 422 without changing assignments when a removed attribute is used by a category product.

get.summary: List attribute groups assigned to a category

put.summary: Replace attribute groups assigned to a category
put.description: Atomically replaces group assignments and detaches attributes from removed groups. Returns 422 without changing either set when an implicitly detached attribute is used by a category product.

get.description: Search matches standalone product name, slug, SKU, article number, or barcode by case-insensitive substring. Price and stock filters apply directly to products.

Downloads every product matching the list filters and sort order without pagination. Requires imports.manage. The Товары sheet uses Russian Admin labels, characteristic names with optional units in parentheses, Russian product units, Да/Нет booleans and option labels. No database IDs are included. Slugs are on SEO товаров and SEO характеристик sheets. SKU and barcode remain text; multiselect labels are semicolon-separated with CSV quoting. Trailing Изображение N columns contain absolute public URLs for every gallery image, primary first then gallery order. Their count matches the largest filtered gallery; missing images are blank. Includes filters, centered frozen headers and formatted numeric/date cells. The importer accepts both this localized workbook and legacy technical workbooks; image columns are informational and preserve the gallery.

get.summary: Download a category-specific product creation template
get.description: Requires imports.manage. Up to 5000 products in rows 2–5001, no SKU column, optional product slug, category-only attributes. List and boolean cells have Stop validation with IDs and labels on a hidden lookup sheet. Multiselect uses separate dropdown slots.

post.description: Requires imports.manage. With category_id, creates products from the selected category template with independent row transactions and durable progress/errors; SKU and blank slugs are generated automatically. Duplicate names/slugs and values absent from current option lists fail only that row. Without category_id, preserves atomic legacy/export create-update import compatibility. Limit: 5000 products, 10 MiB.

category_id.description: Selected category for create-only template mode. Omit for legacy/export round-trip import.

get.summary: Get the current user's product import status
Download only failed product rows as a reusable category template
get.description: Requires imports.manage, ownership, completed/failed status and at least one failed row. The XLSX includes original failed values with current category fields and dropdown validations; correct and reupload it with category_id.

patch.description: A category change is atomic and returns 422 when the destination omits an attribute used by the product. Missing assignment-required values are allowed only while inactive; activation returns 422 until all required values are valid.

delete.description: Serialises with product-image mutations, deletes the product and its dependent records, then removes every collected product-image file from its configured storage disk after the database transaction commits.

put.description: A category change is atomic and returns 422 when the destination omits an attribute used by the product. Missing assignment-required values are allowed only while inactive; activation returns 422 until all required values are valid.

post.description: Requires at least two same-category and same-brand standalone products, scalar category-assigned axes, unique axis tuples, and equal non-axis attributes.

patch.description: Atomically replaces the supplied group definition and revalidates every group invariant.

put.description: Uses the same partial-update validation as PATCH and atomically revalidates every group invariant.

delete.summary: Delete a product variation group without deleting member products

put.description: Fully replaces the requested product values. For grouped products, axis values affect only the requested product, while supplied or omitted non-axis values are atomically synchronized across all group members.

get.description: Returns an unpaginated product collection excluding the source product and products with an existing outgoing or incoming relation. Search matches name, slug, or SKU.

put.description: Serialises replacements involving the same products and rejects self-references or reverse relations, including concurrent requests.

StoreAttributeRequest.description: Choice attributes require a non-empty full option set.

UpdateAttributeRequest.description: When supplied for a choice attribute, options is a non-empty full replacement. Without type it is validated against the current stored type. Existing product and legacy migration values must remain valid for the prospective definition.

is_required.description: Category-assignment requiredness when the resource is returned in category context; false otherwise.

sku_prefix.description: Server-owned one- or two-digit root product-type prefix inherited by descendants. Multiples of ten are not allocated. Null is possible only for a legacy or directly inserted category until first use.

sku.description: Server-generated immutable <type><NNNNNN> identifier with a one- or two-digit category type. Null or a legacy format is possible only for a row created before automatic numbering.

primary_image.description: The product-owned primary image, or null when the product has no images.

axis_values.description: Present only when the product is embedded as a product-group member.

status.description: completed means every row was checked, including partial/all row errors. failed means file or infrastructure failure; prior category-template successes remain committed.

ProductGroupMember.description: A standalone Product resource plus axis_values containing only this group's selected axis attributes.

AttributeValue.description: The concrete JSON shape is selected by Attribute.type: string is a non-empty string up to 255 characters; text is a non-empty string up to 10000 characters; integer is a JSON integer; decimal is a finite JSON number; boolean is a JSON boolean; select is one option value (including a HEX color code when the attribute represents a color); multiselect is a non-empty unique array of up to 500 option values; date is a real calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Colors use select options rather than a separate attribute type.

Unauthenticated.description: Authentication is required or the supplied credentials are invalid.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated administrator is blocked or does not have access.
